name: Open
why: A site's code, from a private repo to a public one anyone can fork
ideal: The public repo holds no secret, private path or reserved name, takes changes only by pull request, pins every action and answers issues fast.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Configuring issue templates for your repository

steps.name: Export
steps.rule: Every change reaches the public repo by pull request, after the export check.

steps.name: Intake
tools: CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY and a code of conduct
steps.rule: Issue forms route each bug and quick fix; the open-repo files say how to help.

steps.name: Pin
steps.rule: Every action is pinned to a full commit SHA that Dependabot bumps.

steps.name: Answer
steps.rule: Each issue closes by a merged fix or a reply within days.

steps.name: Cost
steps.rule: A contribution's CI runs on free runners in minutes.
